name: Guinea-Bissau
famous_for: The pristine Bijagós Archipelago (UNESCO Biosphere Reserve with saltwater hippos), and vibrant Portuguese-creole culture.
tourists: Approx. 60,000 visitors; famous for saltwater hippos in Orango National Park and Bissau Carnival.
must_know: The Bijagós Archipelago still preserves a matriarchal clan society where women hold immense social and religious leadership.
fun_fact: Orango National Park in Bijagós is one of the only places on Earth where hippos spend hours bathing in ocean surf.
